_comment: nimWifi configuration example. Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored. All hosts are fictitious (example.com); replace them with yours.
_credentials: Secret values, referenced as ${secret.NAME}. Stored apart from the definitions, never shown or exported, excluded from backups. Leave this out and set them on the phone (Imported configuration > Credentials) if you do not want them in a file.
_throughput: Speed tests after each Stop-and-Go scan. iperf: your private iperf3 server (iperf3 -s). internet: an HTTP speed test; {bytes} is replaced by the download size.
_guide: Survey guide: grid spacing and coverage circle in metres, the SSID shown on the map and the signal profile (pda -67/-72, voz -67/-67, datos -70/-75 dBm).
_roaming: Continuous mode: the service is watched during the whole route. method tcp = a TCP connect to host:port every intervalMs; method icmp = one ping to host every intervalMs (at least 500 ms; port not used). ${gateway} = the Wi-Fi default gateway, ${dns} = its first DNS server. alias names the target in reports; trace keeps a bounded log of every attempt.
_tests: Network tests at every point: dns (UDP query to the network's DNS server), ping (ICMP, TCP fallback), tcp (connect time) and http (timed GET). alias is the name shown in reports.
_scripts: HTTP scripts: requests chained with variables, values extracted from JSON responses and cookies. Only GET/HEAD run unless a step sets allowWrite (the import asks for an extra confirmation). Each .har file in this ZIP becomes one more script (credentials stripped).

steps._comment: Login: the token in the response is used by the next step.
steps.name: login
